subject.title: fix(gateway): session workspace reveal hangs on foreground opener

question: Which active PR should be the canonical implementation for the shared Gateway path-opener lifecycle: this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109126?
rationale: Both supplied PR descriptions claim overlapping bounded platform-launch behavior but differ on whether the lifecycle belongs in the shared helper or a config-specific owner; this is an ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt this shared-owner PR
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical `open-path` lifecycle and close or narrow the config-specific alternative after verifying its caller coverage.

options.title: Adopt the config-specific PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109126 and ensure session workspace reveal receives the same canonical behavior without duplicate lifecycle code.

options.title: Request a consolidated replacement
options.body: Ask for one minimal branch that retains the chosen lifecycle owner and removes overlap between the two proposals.

recommendation.title: Adopt this shared-owner PR
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical `open-path` lifecycle and close or narrow the config-specific alternative after verifying its caller coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the latest integration commits on the branch are authored by steipete.
